mapper.select:
select p.pos_id as position_id, p.pos_title as title, c.cmp_id as company_id, c.cmp_name as company, c.cmp_logo_url as company_logo, c.cmp_verify_status as company_verified, p.pos_work_city as city, p.pos_salary_min as salary_min, p.pos_salary_max as salary_max, p.pos_experience_required as experience, p.pos_education_required as education, p.pos_job_type as job_type, json_unquote(json_extract(p.pos_jd_json, '$.description')) as description, group_concat(distinct ps.psk_name order by ps.psk_required desc separator ',') as tags_csv, least(98, 60 + if(u.target_direction is not null and (p.pos_title like concat('%', u.target_direction, '%') or u.target_direction like concat('%', p.pos_title, '%')), 15, 0) + if(coalesce(u.target_city, u.current_city) = p.pos_work_city, 10, 0) + least(15, count(distinct rs.skl_name) * 5) + if(p.pos_created_at >= date_sub(now(), interval 7 day), 5, 0)) as match_score, exists(select 1 from t_app_record ar join t_tal t on t.tal_id = ar.app_candidate_id where t.tal_user_id = #{userId} and ar.app_position_id = p.pos_id) as applied from t_pos p join t_cmp c on c.cmp_id = p.pos_company_id and c.cmp_status = 1 join sys_user u on u.user_id = #{userId} left join t_pos_skill ps on ps.psk_position_id = p.pos_id left join t_res_base rb on rb.rbs_user_id = #{userId} and rb.rbs_status = 1 left join t_res_skill rs on rs.skl_resume_id = rb.rbs_id and rs.skl_name = ps.psk_name where p.pos_status = 1
and (p.pos_title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or c.cmp_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or exists(select 1 from t_pos_skill search_skill where search_skill.psk_position_id = p.pos_id and search_skill.psk_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')))
and p.pos_created_at >= date_sub(now(), interval 30 day)
and p.pos_salary_max >= 30000
and (p.pos_title like '%NLP%' or exists(select 1 from t_pos_skill nlp_skill where nlp_skill.psk_position_id = p.pos_id and nlp_skill.psk_name like '%NLP%'))
and (c.cmp_size like '%500%' or c.cmp_size like '%1000%' or c.cmp_size like '%以上%')
group by p.pos_id, p.pos_title, c.cmp_id, c.cmp_name, c.cmp_logo_url, c.cmp_verify_status, p.pos_work_city, p.pos_salary_min, p.pos_salary_max, p.pos_experience_required, p.pos_education_required, p.pos_job_type, p.pos_jd_json, p.pos_created_at, u.target_direction, u.target_city, u.current_city
order by p.pos_created_at desc order by p.pos_salary_max desc, match_score desc order by match_score desc, p.pos_created_at desc
limit #{limit}
select count(*) from t_pos where pos_status = 1 and pos_created_at >= date_sub(now(), interval 7 day)

select ar.app_id as applicationId, p.pos_title as title, c.cmp_name as company, ar.app_status as status, case ar.app_status when 0 then '待筛选' when 1 then '已通过初筛' when 2 then '初筛未通过' when 3 then '已约面' when 4 then '待笔试' when 5 then '笔试中' when 6 then '笔试通过' when 7 then '笔试未通过' when 8 then '笔试缺考' else '处理中' end as statusLabel, case ar.app_status when 0 then 20 when 1 then 40 when 3 then 70 when 4 then 50 when 5 then 60 when 6 then 80 when 2 then 100 when 7 then 100 when 8 then 100 else 30 end as progress from t_app_record ar join t_tal t on t.tal_id = ar.app_candidate_id join t_pos p on p.pos_id = ar.app_position_id join t_cmp c on c.cmp_id = p.pos_company_id where t.tal_user_id = #{userId} order by ar.app_updated_at desc, ar.app_id desc limit #{limit}
select rbs_id from t_res_base where rbs_user_id = #{userId} and rbs_status = 1 order by rbs_is_default desc, rbs_updated_at desc, rbs_id desc limit 1
select pos_company_id from t_pos where pos_id = #{positionId} and pos_status = 1
select tal_id from t_tal where tal_user_id = #{userId} and tal_company_id = #{companyId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into t_tal (tal_user_id, tal_company_id, tal_resume_id, tal_status, tal_created_at, tal_updated_at) values (#{userId}, #{companyId}, #{resumeId}, 0, now(), now())
mapper.select: select count(*) from t_app_record where app_candidate_id = #{candidateId} and app_position_id = #{positionId}
mapper.insert: insert into t_app_record (app_candidate_id, app_position_id, app_resume_id, app_matched_score, app_status, app_created_at, app_updated_at) select #{candidateId}, p.pos_id, #{resumeId}, 60, 0, now(), now() from t_pos p where p.pos_id = #{positionId} and p.pos_status = 1
